relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: Converts the Unicode codepoints after the 'xn--' ACE prefix to a UTF-8 byte string via u32_to_u8. When the label is exactly 'xn--' with no payload, e - s - 4 == 0 so u32_to_u8 is called with length 0. It returns a heap-allocated buffer (ace) with ace_len == 0, containing no valid bytes.

Missing guard: the statement `b += delim(input[b])` executes unconditionally regardless of input_length. When input_length == 0, b == 0 from the preceding loop that never executed, and input[0] is out of bounds. The fix adds `if (input_length)` before this statement.

The expression delim(input[b]) unconditionally reads input[0] to check whether the character at position b is the Punycode delimiter (hyphen-minus, 0x2D). When input_length == 0, input[0] is beyond the valid buffer, reading uninitialized heap memory. MSAN reports the tainted result at line 166 where b is used in control flow.

edges.description: ace_len from the u32_to_u8 result at the call site propagates as the input_length parameter to _idn2_punycode_decode. When ace_len == 0, input_length == 0 at the callee.
